rationale: Two quality gates fail. The pass rate is 86.7% against a target of 95%, and there is 1 open major defect against a limit of 0. Both come from SL-402, which undercharges every percentage-coupon order, a direct revenue impact that also matches the top-ranked risk R1 (high likelihood, high impact). The smoke suite is green and there are no open critical defects, so the release is close: one fix and re-test should clear both gates.
blocking_issues: SL-402: percentage coupon calculated on subtotal plus delivery fee (open, major)
Pass rate 86.7% is below the 95% gate
conditions: SL-402 is fixed in rc4 and verified by PRC-001 and CHK-002
The pricing and checkout regression suites are re-run with a pass rate of at least 95%
Alternative if the fix slips: ship with percentage coupons switched off via the coupons.percent flag, with Product sign-off

residual_risks.risk: R2: the coupon usage index migration may lock the coupon_usage table
residual_risks.mitigation: Run it in the low-traffic window; it has been rehearsed on a production-sized copy

residual_risks.risk: R3: Apple Pay is untested on staging
residual_risks.mitigation: None recorded. Add a production smoke test right after deployment and monitor Apple Pay success rates

recommendations: Ship coupon changes behind the coupons.percent flag so they can be switched off quickly
Watch average discount per order and the coupon error rate for 48 hours after release
Keep a rollback plan for migration 0042 and a hotfix window open for the first 24 hours
